nodes.title: Initial split topology
nodes.change: Compared early disaggregated layouts and repaired setup/protocol issues.
nodes.outcome: 07 job 22197 reached 1,297.02 good output tokens/s at N32; 09 job 22131 reached 1,472.73 at N32 and job 22200 reached 1,649.27 at N40. Separate topology job 22219 reached 1,666.01 at N40. The layouts and loads differ; these are feasibility milestones, not a causal ablation.

nodes.title: Heterogeneous TP8 warmup failure
nodes.change: Workers loaded, but pair warmup timed out before benchmark scoring.
nodes.outcome: No score; localized the problem to setup/transfer path and motivated inspecting KV descriptor work.

nodes.title: Request-scoped NIXL descriptors
nodes.change: Built and coalesced descriptors only for request pages after 720 CPU equivalence cases.
nodes.outcome: Actual P/D warmup completed; N32 scored 1,422.96 good tokens/s. Establishes patched-path feasibility, not descriptor-only speedup.

nodes.title: Equal-TP recovery and preserved losses
nodes.change: Retained partial and timeout attempts; tested a separately scoped equal-TP8 descriptor route.
nodes.outcome: 22809 reached 1,507.96 at N32 but only 95.38% joint SLA; N40/N48 failed eligibility. Not selected.

nodes.title: Usable split baseline
nodes.change: Kept two TP4 prefill replicas feeding TP8/EP8 decode; established full runs and controls.
nodes.outcome: 22415 delivered N48 at 1,912.30; later controls near 1,911. This became a matched-tuning baseline.

nodes.title: Round-robin prefill routing
nodes.change: Changed routing after poor first-token latency; followed with a fresh control.
nodes.outcome: Pilot 23325 scored 2,402.64 vs 2,075.11 control and lowered mean TTFT 1,437.63→333.25 ms; single observation, ITL approached limit.

nodes.title: FP8 KV and decode DeepGEMM losses
nodes.change: Tested each backend on the routed pipeline at matched N52.
nodes.outcome: Both failed joint SLA; retained BF16 KV and closed those tested branches. Does not rule out phase-specific use.

nodes.title: MNNVL plus FlashInfer interaction
nodes.change: Tested communication/attention paths and their combined pipeline with repeat evidence.
nodes.outcome: MNNVL reached 2,592.16 and repeat ~2,592.92, about 8% over matched N52 control; FlashInfer alone near tie. Combined configuration reached later 2,632.61.

nodes.title: H100 platform becomes measurable
nodes.change: Separated PBS launch and loader failures from a completed baseline.
nodes.outcome: First full N32 point ~1,565.16 after long startup; H100 performance remains a separate series.

nodes.title: H100 HPC-Ops decode
nodes.change: Compared decode-only HPC-Ops against controls and repeated the treatment.
nodes.outcome: 2,308.308 vs 2,245.534 (+2.7955%); repeat 2,304.083 stayed above fresh control 221275. ITL improved, TTFT rose.

nodes.title: H100 both-phase HPC-Ops
nodes.change: Added prefill HPC-Ops to the retained decode path and refined load with repeat controls.
nodes.outcome: Initial 2,371.961 vs 2,308.979 control; later N54 2,430.891 and repeat 2,418.588. N56 did not establish further gain.

nodes.title: DeepGEMM specifically in prefill
nodes.change: Changed prefill only after a decode-only DeepGEMM loss; held decode and workload, then repeated.
nodes.outcome: 24291 reached 2,715.842; independent 24327 reached 2,716.787, +1.7401% vs fresh control 24320. H100 did not inherit this result.

nodes.title: H100 prefill alternatives lose
nodes.change: Matched tests covered chunk6144, selectors and dense FlashInfer prefill.
nodes.outcome: Chunk6144 2,411.995 vs 2,413.802 control; dense FlashInfer 2,227.031 (−7.74%). Passing gates did not mean improvement.

nodes.title: HPC-Ops decode with DeepGEMM/chunk8192
nodes.change: Revisited decode backend under changed prefill runner/chunk and compared against a same-load control.
nodes.outcome: N58 candidate 2,938.628 vs 2,780.403 (+5.6907%); TTFT rose, ITL improved. Promising interaction, not yet confirmed by this pair alone.

nodes.title: Separate N60 repeat/control
nodes.change: Repeated the incumbent auto-decode configuration separately from the N58 treatment.
nodes.outcome: 24732 2,836.531 vs 2,839.532 original control; confirms stability of that configuration only, not the N58 treatment.

nodes.title: N60 HPC-Ops interaction repeat
nodes.change: Ran fresh matched controls and independently repeated the promising phase interaction.
nodes.outcome: Repeat improved 5.295% vs matched auto-decode control and was ~0.033% below original treatment; mean TTFT/ITL tradeoff retained.

nodes.title: H100 load/chunk frontier
nodes.change: Measured chunk and load interactions with full-run latency gates.
nodes.outcome: N54 control 222281 scored 2,401.578; smaller chunk2048 lost ~26.13%; 8192 and later H100 chunk branches did not establish a useful gain.

nodes.title: N62 to N64 matched load
nodes.change: Tested a bounded concurrency increase on the revised recipe.
nodes.outcome: N62 3,011.875; N64 3,044.490 (+1.082867%) under full gates. This motivated a repeat, not a claim of certainty.

nodes.title: Independent N64 repeat
nodes.change: Repeated the selected N64 configuration under the full protocol.
nodes.outcome: 3,044.075, −0.013634% vs first N64; supported the historical repeated mean 3,044.400475.

nodes.title: N64 versus N68 stop
nodes.change: Compared fresh full N64/N68 runs after the repeated N64 result.
nodes.outcome: Only +0.083056% at N68 while mean TTFT rose ~1,113.6→1,347.1 ms; retained N64 and closed N68.

nodes.title: H100 repeated frontier remains separate
nodes.change: Reviewed three H100 full runs with independent observations.
nodes.outcome: 2,433.020 / 2,395.311 / 2,406.802 good tokens/s; no pooling with H200 3,044 series.

nodes.title: Tokenizer, prefill attention and EAGLE losses
nodes.change: Tested targeted backend/serving alternatives with same incumbent context.
nodes.outcome: Dynamic tokenizer gains +0.192/+0.270% not promoted; FlashInfer prefill −6.385%; shallow EAGLE3 −2.080%.

nodes.title: Native full N64 reproduction
nodes.change: Replayed the retained native configuration with current gates.
nodes.outcome: 3,045.501509 good output tokens/s; separate series from historical repeated mean.

nodes.title: Cold-prefill cache candidate
nodes.change: Compared a cache intervention to its own fresh control.
nodes.outcome: Candidate peak 3,048.446289 but only +0.240921%, below 1% gate; p95 TTFT worsened. No promotion.

nodes.title: Sparse decode graph experiment
nodes.change: Reduced graph buckets to test memory proxy hypothesis.
nodes.outcome: 3,029.861122 (−0.370208%); memory/rank fell 1.15→0.36 GB but throughput did not improve.

nodes.title: Direct H100-derived recipe check on H200
nodes.change: Fresh H200 control, FA3 decode and H100 recipe at N54/N64; preserved same-GPU comparison.
nodes.outcome: Control 3,038.022907; FA3 −1.276%; H100 recipe N64 −10.408%. Retained H200-specific recipe; no pooled GPU ranking.

nodes.title: Refine transferred recipe chunk
nodes.change: Held HPC-Ops prefill runner and tested chunk6144/8192, then compared at shared chunk.
nodes.outcome: 2,821.885 / 2,900.607; chunk8192 recovered vs 4096 but remained 4.523% below incumbent.

nodes.title: Phase-specific inference mode
nodes.change: Compared decode-only and prefill-only inference_mode ports with explicit no_grad control.
nodes.outcome: 3,039.167 control; +0.006223% decode and +0.130765% prefill. Below 1% gate; no promotion.

nodes.title: Exact packaged entry failure and acceptance
nodes.change: Fixed readiness check after health returned before model registration; reran exact entry.
nodes.outcome: 28194 failed before benchmark; 28197 passed in 611 s at N64, 3,051.518173 good output tokens/s. Acceptance, not matched optimization.

nodes.title: N16 quality pilot fails point threshold
nodes.change: Compared a bounded pilot before committing the full fixed study.
nodes.outcome: The first reference attempt 28367 failed; corrected reference 28371 scored 104 correct and candidate 28368 scored 102 (98.076923% retention). The pilot failed the local 99% point gate and motivated the full-set measurement.

nodes.title: Complete paired local answer-quality test
nodes.change: Compared stock FP8 and accepted candidate on the same 12,032 MMLU-Pro questions, fixed prompts/settings/parser, in eight paired shards.
nodes.outcome: Reference 9,460/12,032 (78.623670%); candidate 9,452/12,032 (78.557181%); 99.915433% reference-score retention passes local 99% point gate. Not BTC certification or statistical equivalence.

edges.reason: The topology search exposed a warmup failure before scoring, motivating transfer-path inspection.
The patch directly targets full-pool descriptor work identified in the failed warmup path.
The later equal-TP recovery addresses a related descriptor path after preserving failures.
The later measured baseline retains the workable TP4-prefill/TP8-decode family; this is architectural continuity, not one-factor causality.
A usable baseline made a matched routing question possible after first-token latency concerns.
Backend alternatives were tested on the routed pipeline at fixed load.
The route changed sustained phase behavior and motivated measuring backend interactions.
Decode-only DeepGEMM loss did not answer the distinct prefill question.
H100 baseline enabled platform-local decode testing.
Repeated decode evidence motivated testing prefill independently on H100.
Later H100 prefill alternatives use the platform-specific incumbent as controls.
The prefill runner change made prior decode comparisons stale and motivated the runner/chunk interaction test.
Fresh matched controls and an independent repeat checked the promising interaction.
N60 repeat/control evidence is separate from the N58 interaction; later controls continue matched validation.
The H100 chunk/load experiments use H100 controls and preserve their own frontier.
The repeated revised recipe made bounded concurrency re-evaluation the next question.
The independent repeat checks the N64 candidate directly.
Repeated N64 evidence justified one bounded higher-load comparison.
Panel concern about cross-platform transfer motivated direct H200 verification of H100-derived choices.
The full transfer changed runner and chunk together, so chunk was isolated as the next question.
A separate hypothesis tested whether phase-specific inference mode helps on H200.
Later full N64 reproduction is explicitly a separate native series, not a matched treatment to historical runs.
A later cache candidate was evaluated against a fresh control and prospective usefulness gate.
Sparse graph result was compared against an earlier dense-graph incumbent; it is a distinct intervention.
After cross-platform verification, the exact packaged entry was retried to close deployment acceptance.
Performance acceptance did not establish answer quality; a separate local quality check was needed.
The pilot failed the point gate, motivating the fixed complete paired test.
